reasons.title: Some things I should have said out loud…

items.text: Every time my phone lights up with your name, the day gets 10% better. Science calls it dopamine. I call it you.
You make ordinary Tuesdays feel like something worth remembering.
Laughing with you is my favorite sound in any room.
I've run out of reasons to wait. So here I am, asking properly.
